description: Coverage ignored: unsecured backing always counts in full
A default does not burn the unsecured backers' credit
A default does not slash the secured backers' stake
Free credit ignores the backer's own loans
Received backing can be passed on
Backing with credit does not record the commitment
Backing can be cut below what the borrower owes
Backing is released at a default while the borrower has other open loans
A defaulted account keeps its granted credit
A new loan is checked against the limit, not the unused limit
Dues are credited on interest net of the fee, not the reserve share
The owner may release dues from the reserve
